verdict.rationale: Exa is an API-first product. It documents REST endpoints with curl examples, offers downloadable OpenAPI specs for its public API, ships official Python and JS SDKs, and publishes llms.txt docs. A hands-on user also reported being impressed with the search API while integrating it into an agentic chatbot. missing for 10: OpenAPI spec not discoverable at standard machine paths (probe 404s), and one hands-on report of an incorrectly escaped generated cURL snippet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Download the OpenAPI specs for the Exa public API and Team Management API in YAML or JSON.
Prefer the official SDKs, `exa-py` (`pip install exa-py`) and `exa-js` (`npm install exa-js`); both read `EXA_API_KEY` from the environment.
Exa Search is a web search API that takes a natural language query and returns ranked web results with clean page content.
